reason: The rocky world and fast projectiles directly match the goal of bringing it through the remaining stones.

choice.combine: The rocky world with a small moon

expectation: The world will encounter the projectiles while retaining its moon.

effect: The attempted pairing instead revealed and automatically performed the world's combination with its host star, completing the rocky-world goal.
reaction: I was surprised the star was the required partner, although the result followed the expected encounter with stones.
reason: The exposed gas and inner disk directly match the remaining goal of following disk material outward.

choice.combine: Exposed gas carrying small dust grains

expectation: The exposed disk material will begin moving away from the system into the galaxy.

effect: The exposed inner disk combination returned gas and dust to the nursery and completed the remaining goal.
reaction: The contrast between early disk dispersal and the rocky world's later collisions was interesting.

mostWorthwhile.text: Following the disk material back into the nursery was worthwhile because it connected the young system to its galactic surroundings.

leastWorthwhile.text: The first pairing was confusing: the goal mentioned remaining stones, but the rocky world needed its host star as its partner.

surprise.text: The incompatible projectile pairing automatically led to the star combination, which still described the expected encounters with stones.

arbitrary.text: Using the host star rather than the visible projectiles felt somewhat arbitrary until the result widened the view to the whole system.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the return of disk material to the nursery made me curious about its later encounters.
